title: Streamable-HTTP transport mode
summary: Opt-in MCP Streamable-HTTP transport selectable via a --transport CLI flag at server startup; lets clients connect to a long-running server URL instead of spawning a new stdio process per session — eliminates the client-reload step when server code changes.
acceptance: Server boots over HTTP when started with --transport http; initialize and tools/list succeed against the HTTP endpoint; representative tool calls return identical results vs stdio; README documents both modes including the no-reload dev loop
notes: Shipped via PR #8 (merge 368edaa); v0.5.0 released; supersedes F-T3-HTTP. Surfaced and fixed two bugs during macOS verification — Claude Desktop is stdio-only (mcp-remote bridge documented) and per-session transports were needed to avoid "Server already initialized"
